# 888漫步旅遊 · 888RoamTravel (RoamRadar) - Full LLM & API Reference

> Machine-readable specification and guide for AI Agents, autonomous planners, and automation systems integrating with RoamRadar.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Invariants

RoamRadar is a privacy-first, single-tenant personal travel hub. All data is persisted in Cloudflare KV as a unified store.

### The Invariant Rules
1. **Manual Invariant**: Any segment created or updated via the Agent API is assigned `source: "manual"`. The background sync engine (which periodically scans Google Calendar and Gmail) will **NEVER** overwrite, modify, or delete manual plans.
2. **Category Fidelity**: Categories must strictly match one of the 7 supported values:
   - `flight` ✈️: Flight bookings, airport codes, flight numbers.
   - `hotel` 🏨: Accommodations, hotels, ryokans, villas, Airbnbs.
   - `restaurant` 🍽️: Dining, restaurants, cafes, food stalls, ramen shops, izakayas.
   - `rail` 🚆: Trains, high-speed rail (Shinkansen, TGV, ICE), subways, scenic railways.
   - `car` 🚗: Rental cars, car hire pick-up and drop-off.
   - `ride` 🚕: Taxi, airport pick-up, Uber, private chauffeur.
   - `other` 📍: Sightseeing attractions, theme parks, museum entries, appointments.
3. **Contingency / Fallback Plans**: Any segment can hold an embedded `fallback` object representing a backup alternative. If the primary plan is full, closed, or delayed, the user can switch to the fallback plan in 1 click in the UI.

---

## 2. Authentication

External agents authenticate using an HTTP Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer rr_agent_<token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

Agent keys are generated in the RoamRadar Web App (Settings -> AI Agent Integration). Tokens are prefixed with `rr_agent_` and can be regenerated or revoked at any time.

---

## 3. Data Schemas

### Trip Schema
```json
{
  "id": "t_202610_tokyo",             // string (unique ID; auto-assigned if omitted)
  "from": "TPE",                      // string (origin airport IATA or city name)
  "to": "NRT",                        // string (destination airport IATA or city name)
  "start": "2026-10-15",              // string (YYYY-MM-DD)
  "end": "2026-10-20",                // string (YYYY-MM-DD)
  "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",     // string (human-friendly trip title)
  "notes": "Flight booked via BR198", // string (free-text trip notes)
  "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",           // string (IANA timezone, e.g. "Asia/Tokyo")
  "photo": "https://example.com/p.jpg", // string (optional custom banner photo URL)
  "segments": [],                     // Segment[] (itinerary plans)
  "updatedAt": 1729000000000          // number (epoch timestamp ms)
}
```

### Segment Schema
```json
{
  "sid": "s_123456",                  // string (unique segment ID; auto-assigned if omitted)
  "type": "restaurant",               // string ("flight"|"hotel"|"restaurant"|"car"|"ride"|"rail"|"other")
  "name": "Ichiran Ramen Shibuya",    // string (plan title / business name)
  "address": "1-22-7 Jinnan, Shibuya",// string (optional formatted address or location)
  "note": "18:00 Dinner reservation", // string (optional notes, times, seat info)
  "start": "2026-10-15T18:00",        // string (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)
  "end": "2026-10-15T19:30",          // string (optional YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)
  "conf": "RES-889900",               // string (optional confirmation / booking reference)
  "source": "manual",                 // string (always "manual" for agent items)
  "rating": 4.5,                      // number (optional Google rating, 1.0 - 5.0)
  "userRatingsTotal": 2450,           // number (optional total review count)
  "openNow": true,                    // boolean (optional current open status)
  "mapsUrl": "https://maps.google.com/?cid=123", // string (optional Google Maps link)
  "placeId": "ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4",      // string (optional Google Place ID)
  "fallback": {                       // object (optional contingency alternative)
    "name": "Afuri Ramen Harajuku",
    "address": "1-1-7 Jingumae, Shibuya",
    "note": "Backup option if Ichiran line exceeds 30 mins",
    "mapsUrl": "https://maps.google.com/?cid=456",
    "rating": 4.3,
    "userRatingsTotal": 1820
  }
}
```

---

## 4. API Endpoints Specification

### 4.1 Trips Endpoints

#### `GET /api/v1/trips`
Retrieves all trips sorted chronologically by start date.
- **Request**: No body required.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "count": 1,
  "trips": [
    {
      "id": "t_202610_tokyo",
      "from": "TPE",
      "to": "NRT",
      "start": "2026-10-15",
      "end": "2026-10-20",
      "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",
      "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
      "segmentCount": 5,
      "segments": [...]
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `GET /api/v1/trips/:id`
Retrieves details of a single trip by ID.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "trip": { ... }
}
```

#### `POST /api/v1/trips`
Creates a new trip.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "from": "TPE",
  "to": "NRT",
  "start": "2026-10-15",
  "end": "2026-10-20",
  "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",
  "notes": "Trip planned by AI assistant",
  "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
  "segments": [ ... ]
}
```
- **Response**: `201 Created` with created trip object.

#### `PUT /api/v1/trips/:id`
Updates an existing trip's properties (dates, destination, label, notes, timezone).
- **Response**: `200 OK` with updated trip object.

#### `DELETE /api/v1/trips/:id`
Deletes a trip and all its segments.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "deleted": true,
  "id": "t_202610_tokyo"
}
```

---

### 4.2 Segments Endpoints

#### `POST /api/v1/trips/:id/segments`
Appends one or more itinerary segments to an existing trip.
- **Batch Support**: Accepts either a single segment object `{ ... }` or an array of segment objects `[ { ... }, { ... } ]`.
- **Request Body (Batch Example)**:
```json
[
  {
    "type": "flight",
    "name": "BR198 TPE to NRT",
    "start": "2026-10-15T08:50",
    "end": "2026-10-15T13:15",
    "conf": "BR-78910",
    "note": "Terminal 2, Seat 12A"
  },
  {
    "type": "hotel",
    "name": "Hotel Gracery Shinjuku",
    "address": "1-19-1 Kabukicho, Shinjuku, Tokyo",
    "start": "2026-10-15",
    "end": "2026-10-20",
    "conf": "HG-9921",
    "note": "Check-in from 14:00"
  },
  {
    "type": "restaurant",
    "name": "Ramen Nagi Shinjuku Golden Gai",
    "address": "1-1-10 Kabukicho, Shinjuku",
    "start": "2026-10-15T19:00",
    "note": "Top rated niboshi ramen",
    "fallback": {
      "name": "Ichiran Shinjuku Chuo-Higashiguchi",
      "address": "3-34-11 Shinjuku",
      "note": "Backup if Nagi wait exceeds 40 mins"
    }
  }
]
```
- **Response**: `201 Created`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "count": 3,
  "segments": [ ... ]
}
```

#### `PUT /api/v1/trips/:id/segments/:sid`
Updates an existing segment.
- **Request Body**: Any editable fields (`name`, `address`, `note`, `start`, `end`, `conf`, `fallback`, `rating`, `openNow`, `mapsUrl`, etc.).
- **Response**: `200 OK` with updated segment object.

#### `DELETE /api/v1/trips/:id/segments/:sid`
Removes a segment from the trip and records its confirmation reference into `deletedSegs` tombstone store.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "deleted": true,
  "sid": "s_123456"
}
```

---

## 5. Agent Planning Best Practices

1. **Chronological Consistency**: Ensure segment start times fall within the trip's `start` and `end` bounds.
2. **Time Formatting in Notes**: RoamRadar's timeline parser automatically extracts clock times (e.g. `09:00-11:30` or `19:00`) from the `note` field to order same-day events. Include explicit times in either `start` or `note`.
3. **Proactive Fallbacks**: When recommending popular dining or outdoor attractions, automatically attach a fallback alternative in the `fallback` field to provide the user with peace of mind.
